💵 Pricing

Founding rate $247/mo for the first 3 months, then $497/mo. Setup is waived ($500 value) for the first 5 founding members in each market, in exchange for a testimonial and permission to share results. One plan, no per-minute billing, month-to-month, cancel anytime. 30-day money-back guarantee covers the first month. Standard SMS and email usage is billed at cost, estimated up front. The $247 rate is an introductory founding price, not the ongoing rate.

Checked Nov 23, 2026
⏱️ Setup

easy — about 48 hours after approval (done-for-you and async; no call required)

🎯 Best for

Garage door HVAC Plumbers Roofers Pest control

👍 Pros

  • One published plan with no per-minute meters, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee on the first month and cancel-anytime billing
  • Built for home-service trades, including garage door: answers calls and website chat, qualifies, books the calendar, texts missed calls in under 60 seconds, and follows up unsold estimates
  • Done-for-you setup; vendor says live within 48 hours of approval, with no sales call required
  • Includes a branded CRM, automatic review requests, and a day-14 report of calls answered and jobs booked
  • Free Lead Leak Report to run your own numbers, with no card required

👎 Cons

  • The $247/mo founding rate lasts only 3 months, then the price becomes $497/mo — more than many per-minute or unlimited receptionist plans on this site
  • The waived setup and founding rate are limited to the first 5 members in each market and require a testimonial plus permission to share results
  • Standard SMS and email usage is billed at cost on top of the monthly fee
  • Calendar booking depends on supported integrations being configured; call forwarding to keep your existing number depends on your carrier and is confirmed during onboarding
  • We have not tested booking or missed-call text-back first-hand; the public terms and privacy pages are still marked as templates to be reviewed before ad launch
